overview.content:
4 more pages are reached from these or by address; the page you are on is described in full below, and moving to another page gives you its tools.
Go to any page by its address with [app_navigate]; its path lists every page.
overview.title: The app’s pages

detail.content:
The App page (/apps/:appId).
Where: reached by address (/apps/:appId) or from another page.

What you can do here (tool in brackets):
On the page:
- Get brand [brand_capture]
- Use the theme instead [brand_stop_kit]
- Website [brand_url]
- Share [builder_share]
- Builder [builder_tab]
- Create variant [builder_variant]
- Diagram [diagrams_choose]
- Show derived values [diagrams_derived]
- Download SVG [diagrams_download_svg]
- Download Mermaid [diagrams_download_text]
- Fit to width [diagrams_fit]
- Appearance [look_appearance]
- Theme [look_theme]
- Person [preview_person]
- Reset sample data [preview_reset]
- Share [share_add]
- They can [share_as]
- Done [share_close]
- Share with [share_who]
- Cancel [variant_cancel]
- Create variant [variant_create]
- Name [variant_name]
- What differs [variant_note]
In the Screenshot:
- The app's default appearance [brand_appearance]: The appearance the app opens in once an option is chosen: automatic (the person's setting), light or dark. Takes value: string one of "system", "light", "dark".
- Style (design system) [brand_design_system]: The design system the app is built on: control shapes, density and fonts (Databricks, Material, Fluent or Carbon) Takes value: string.
- Kit name [brand_kit_name]: The name the chosen option is kept under in the brand kit library. Takes value: string.
- Show in [brand_preview_appearance]: Whether the options are shown in light or dark. Takes value: string one of "light", "dark".

App builder (on this page): The app open in the builder: its definition (data, roles, actions, screens, navigation, sample data), its validation, and its live preview.
Actions:
- Set the studio's appearance [app_set_studio_appearance]: The sun/moon button in the studio's top bar
- Apply changes [app_apply_operations]: The builder's edit panels (data, screens, actions, look)
- Set preview [app_set_preview]: The App preview tab and its toolbar: Signed in as, screen and appearance
- Show panel [app_show_panel]: The App configuration tab and its panel tabs
- Create variant [app_create_variant]: The Create variant button
- Restore version [app_restore_version]: A version's Restore button in the Versions panel (confirm first)
- Reset sample data [app_reset_data]: The preview's Reset sample data button (confirm first)
- Get brand from a website [app_capture_brand]: The Brand and style panel's Website field and Get brand button
- Show brand options on a design system [app_set_brand_design_system]: The Brand and style panel's Style (design system) picker
- Use a brand option [app_choose_brand_option]: An option's Use this option button in the Brand and style panel
- Adjust a brand option [app_adjust_brand_option]: An option's Adjust this option sliders in the Brand and style panel
- Reset a brand option [app_reset_brand_option]: An option's Reset to the original button in the Brand and style panel
- Show a brand kit's sources [app_show_brand_sources]: A kit's Sources button in the Brand and style panel
- Ask for a logo file [app_ask_for_logo]: The Brand and style panel's logo file picker
- Use a brand kit [app_apply_brand_kit]: A kit's Use button in the Brand and style panel's library
- Stop using the brand kit [app_stop_brand_kit]: The Brand and style panel's Use the theme instead button
What it reports: definition — What the app holds: name, version, look, roles, records (fields and derived values), relationships, actions, screens, navigation, samples validation — UMF's verdict on the current definition: whether it renders, and every problem and warning to fix preview — The live preview: which builder tab is shown (configuration or preview), who the preview is signed in as, which screen it shows, and the people available brand — The app's look and the brand step: the theme or brand kit it wears, the brand captured from a website or logo (colours and where each was seen, fonts, the suggested design system and what each design system settles of the style rules, the three options with their settings, any adjustments, and any colour rules to review), and the kits in the library problems — What is wrong that a person would see: what the page cannot show, load or do, as its banners and messages say it. Empty when nothing is wrong.

What the page reports: state (its fields, lists and unavailable controls) and problems.
detail.title: App (/apps/:appId)

recipes.name: Create variant and style it
steps: Make it with app_create_variant; the result names it and it is selected.
Read definition and problems; if something is not drawn, fix that before saying it is done.
recipes.trigger: Making something new with Create variant in the App builder

recipes.name: Fix what the App builder reports
steps: Read problems: each says what is wrong, what it hides, and which action resolves it.
Resolve each with the action it names, using one of the choices it offers.
Read definition and problems; if something is not drawn, fix that before saying it is done.
recipes.trigger: problems lists anything, or the user cannot see something

App catalog (on this page): Every app built in this studio. Creating an app opens it in the builder, where its data, screens and actions are designed.
Actions:
- Set the studio's appearance [catalog_set_studio_appearance]: The sun/moon button in the studio's top bar
- Create app [catalog_create_app]: The New app form on the catalog page
- Open app [catalog_open_app]: An app's Open button in the catalog
What it reports: catalog — The apps in the catalog dataCatalog — The organisation's data catalog as the signed-in person sees it: who they are, and every table they may read, with what they may do with it problems — What is wrong that a person would see: what the page cannot show, load or do, as its banners and messages say it. Empty when nothing is wrong.

What the page reports: state (its fields, lists and unavailable controls) and problems.
